spans.s:
n. (-रं)
1 The head.
2 The root of the pepper plant.
f. (-रा)
Any vessel of the body, really, or supposed to be, of a tubular form, as a nerve, a tendon, a gut, &c.
E.
शॄ to injure, क aff.: see शिरस.

m. (-रः)
A large snake, (Boa constrictor.)
E.
शी to sleep, रक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
The root of long-pepper.
f. (-रा)
1 Any tubular vessel of the body, or one so considered, as a nerve, a vein, an artery, a tendon, &c.
2 A bucket, a baling vessel.
E.
षि to bind, aff. रक्, form irr.; also शिर.

m. (-रः)
1 A plough.
2 The sun.
E.
षि to bind, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and the vowel made long; also शीर.

m. (-ली)
A devotee carrying a human scull as his emblem.
E.
शिरस् the head, कपाल the scull, and इनि aff.

f. (-डा)
Pain of the head, head-ache.
E.
शिरस्, and पीडा pain.

m. (-लः)
The cocoa-nut tree.
E.
शिरस् the head, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having the head bathed.
E.
शिरस् and स्नात bathed.

m. (-जः)
The hair of the head.
E.
शिर the head, and ज born.

n. (-रः)
1 The head.
2 The top of a tree.
3 The van of an army.
4 Chief, principal, head.
E.
श्रि to honour, in the passive form, to be honoured, (by the other members,) असुन् Uṇādi aff., and the form irr.

m. (-जः)
The hair of the head.
E.
शिरसि seventh case, in the head, ज born.

m. (-रुट्)
The hair of the head.
E.
शिरसि on the head, रुह् what grows.

n. (-स्कं)
1 A helmet.
2 A turban, a hat or cap.
f. (-स्का)
A litter, a palanquin.
E.
शिरस् the head, and कप् added.

m. (-पी)
An elephant.
E.
शिरस् the head, तप to inflame, णिनि aff.

n. (-स्त्रं)
1 A helmet.
2 A cap, a turban, &c.
E.
शिरस् the head, and त्रै to protect, aff. क.

n. (-णं)
1 A helmet.
2 A cap, a turban, &c.
E.
शिरस् the head, त्राण the instrument of defence^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Of or on the head.
n. (-स्यं)
Clean unentangled hair.
E.
शिरस् the head, यत् aff.

mfn. (-स्स्थः-स्स्था-स्स्थं)
At or on the head, at the top, &c.
m. (-स्थः)
A chief, a leader.
E.
शिरस् head, chief, and स्था to stay or be, aff. क.

m. (-त्रः)
The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantium.)
E.
शिरा a vein, and पत्र leaf.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Veiny, tendinous, skinny, showing the tendons or veins.
n. (-लं)
An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.)
E.
शिरा a vein, लच् poss. aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Cissus quadrangularis.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-त्तं)
Lead.

m. (-रिः).
1 A sword.
2 An arrow.
3 A murderer, a killer.
4 A locust.
E.
शॄ to injure or kill, Uṇādi aff. इ, and the radical vowel changed to इर.

m. (-षः)
A kind of tree, (Atracia sirisa.)
E.
शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. ईषन्.

n. (-हं)
A room on the top of the house, a turret.
E.
शिरस् top, and गृह house.

n. (-वं)
The head and neck.
E.
शिरस् the head, ग्रीव the neck, the compound neuter.

f. (-रा)
The neck.
E.
शिरस् the head, and धर what upholds.

f. (-धिः)
The neck.
E.
शिरस् the head, धा to hold, aff. कि.

mf. (-णिः-णी)
A gem worn in a crest, or on the top of the head.
E.
शिरस् the head, and मणि a jewel.

m. (-र्म्म)
A hog.
E.
शिरस् the head, and मर्म्मन् vitality.

n. (-त्नं)
A gem worn in the crest.
E.
शिरस् the head, and रत्न a jewel.

f. (-जा)
1 A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
2 Pain or diseased affection of the head.
E.
शिरस् the head, and रुजा sickness; a remedy being prepared from the leaves of the plant for head-ache.

m. (-रुट्)
Hair.
E.
शिरस् the head, रुह to grow, क्विप् aff.

m. (-हः)
The hair of the head.
E.
शिरस् the head, रुह to grow, क aff.; also शिरोरुह्.

m. (-गः)
Disease of the head.
E.
शिरस्, and रोग sickness.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
Pain of the head, head-ache, &c.
E.
शिरस् the head, and आर्त्ति pain.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
At the head or top, &c.
m. (-र्त्ती)
A chief; one at the head of affairs or of an army.
E.
शिरस्, and वर्त्तिन् staying.

f. (-ल्ली)
The crest or comb of the peacock.
E.
शिरस् the head, and वल्ली a creeper; it is also read शिरोत्रन्दि.

n. (-त्तं)
Pepper.
E.
शिरस् the head or top, and वृत्त surrounded.

m. (-ष्टः)
1 A turban.
2 A cap.
E.
शिरस् the head, and वेष्ट what surrounds; also शिरोवेष्टन.

n. (-नं)
A turban.
E.
शिरस् the head, and वेष्टन enfolding.

n. (-स्थि)
A scull.
E.
शिरस् the head, and अस्थि a bone.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं.)
1 Thin, small, slender.
2 Wasted, withered, decayed.
E.
शॄ to injure, aff. क्त, form irr.

f. (-ता)
Emaciation, withering.
E.
शीर्ण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीर्णत्वं.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.)
E.
शीर्ण shrivelled or slender, नाल stem.

m. (-त्रः)
A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolium.)
E.
शीर्ण withered, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-दः)
YAMA, the deity of Tartarus.
E.
शीर्ण shrivelled, and पाद a foot.

f. (-का)
A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
शीर्ण shrunk, पुष्प a flower, कन् aff., fem. form.

n. (-न्तं)
A water-melon.
E.
शीर्ण slender, and वृन्त footstalk.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
YAMA, judge of the dead.
E.
शीर्ण shrivelled, and अङ्घ्रि a foot: being shrunk up in consequence of a curse of his mother's.

mfn. (-र्व्विः-र्व्विः-र्व्वि)
Mischievous, malignant, hurtful, savage.
E.
शॄ to injure, क्विन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-र्षं)
The head.
E.
see शिरस्, for which it is substituted.

n. (-कं)
1 A helmet.
2 The skull.
3 Judgment, award, sentence, the fruit or result of judicial investigation.
m. (-कः)
Rāhu, the personified ascending node.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Staying in or on the head.
2 Abiding by an award, agreeing to submit to the penalty imposed by it.
E.
शीर्षक, and स्थ who stays.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 Beheading, decapitating.
2 Striking or injuring the head.
E.
शीर्ष the head, हन to strike, aff. णिनि.

m. (-दः)
Decapitating.
E.
शीर्ष, and छेद cutting; also शीर्षछेदन.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Meriting decapitation.
E.
शीर्ष the head, and छेद cutting, aff. ठक्.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Who or what decapitates.
E.
शीर्ष, and छेदिन् who cuts.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Meriting death by decapitation.
E.
शीर्ष the head, छेद्य to be cut off.

n. (-ण्यं)
A helmet.
m. (-ण्यः)
Clean and unentangled hair.
E.
शीर्षन् substituted for शिरस्, and यत् aff.

n. (-क्षं)
A helmet.
E.
शीर्ष the head, and रक्ष preserving.

m. (-लः)
1 A plexus of vessels.
2 Enlargement of the vessels of the eye.
E.
सिरा, and जाल a net.

m. (-क्षः)
Venesection.
E.
सिरा a vein, and भोक्ष loosing.

m. (-धः)
Venesection.
E.
सिरा, and व्यध piercing; also सिराव्यधनं.

m. (-र्षः)
Flow of discoloured tears.
E.
सिरा, and हर्ष joy.

m. (-तः)
Redness and inflammation of the eyes.
E.
सिरा, and उत्पात affliction.

m. (-कः)
A porpoise.
E.
सीर a plough, कन् aff. of comparison.

m. (-णिः)
BALADEVA.
E.
सीर a plough, and पाणि the hand.

m. (-री)
BALARĀMA.
E.
सीर a plough, and इणि aff.
